negative_results_and_coincidences: Second 'SLB2' match at 0x58DD5EE is inside encrypted data; its following bytes (43 dc f4 28 ...) are not a valid BLS header (version field would be 0x28F4DC43) => coincidence. Expected count in ~1.26 GB random data is ~0.3 occurrences; observed exactly 1.
No ELF magic (0x7f454c46) anywhere in file.
Second occurrence of 0xEEF51454-LE only at 0x400; a big-endian byte-order match at 0x1D61756D is inside encrypted data (coincidence).
ASCII run 'posbp=' at 0x4B2F8E10 is inside the encrypted image; consistent with random-data coincidence (printable 6-gram expected millions of times over 1.26 GB).

Digest-candidate tests for the 32-byte fields at 0x200 and 0x3E0 all negative: sha256 of entry data, entry head64, file regions [0x0,0x200), [0x0,0x3E0), [0x0,0x400), [0x0,0x50), [0x20,0x50), [0x200,0x400), PUP header blob [0x400,0x1790), PUP blob minus 16-byte plaintext, remainder after header blob, whole file; none matched.
